items.title: Charles "Creole Charlie" Levy Interview, 1962-01-03
items.q: Well, you know, after one of the other boys left, we got Tommy Ladnere.

ctx.x: You were the only New Orleans man, then, in Whitliff's band, or what you've been telling me.
Well, you know, after one of the other boys left, we got Tommy Ladnere.
